store.short: The one SQLite database that holds every domain aggregate, the effect queue and the Outbox's receipts.
store.long: {{cite src/app/store.ts:46-50}} is the class; {{cite src/app/runtime.ts:90-93}} locks the state directory before Runtime opens it, so a second process cannot write the same database.
